comps.label: C1
comps.reason: Florida-focused homeowners and condo property carrier, catastrophe-exposed and largely personal lines, unlike diversified national specialty commercial insurance.

comps.label: C2
comps.reason: Risk-bearing specialty commercial P&C carrier writing excess and surplus lines for businesses through brokers, matching AFG's model.

comps.label: C3
comps.reason: Specialty commercial casualty, professional liability and E&S carrier selling through brokers; same underwriting business as AFG.

comps.label: C4
comps.reason: Insurance broker earning commissions and fees without underwriting risk; different economics from a risk-bearing carrier.

comps.label: C5
comps.reason: Personal lines franchised agency earning commissions and royalties; no underwriting and consumer-focused.

comps.label: C6
comps.reason: Regional personal lines carrier focused on New York homeowners and auto, not specialty commercial insurance.

comps.label: C7
comps.reason: Underwrites specialty commercial P&C, including commercial auto, general liability and workers' comp, via brokers; title segment is secondary.

comps.label: C8
comps.reason: Life insurance, funeral, title and mortgage conglomerate; different products and customers than specialty commercial P&C.

comps.label: C9
comps.reason: Title insurance and real estate settlement services tied to housing transactions, not specialty commercial P&C underwriting.

comps.label: C10
comps.reason: Insurance distributor earning commissions and fees, not a risk-bearing carrier; mix includes personal and benefits lines.
